content.text:
**Finding: missing (insurance) — redline validated and submitted.**

- The Agreement has no insurance provision at all; a search for "insurance" returns nothing, and Section 10 (General Provisions) runs from notices through headings/counterparts without any coverage requirement.
- HDI is a hosting/services vendor that designs, hosts and operates the Site on its own servers (Sections 1.1–1.3) and has access to our Content, Confidential Information and Site user data (Section 8.1), so the playbook's vendor insurance position applies.
- Inserted a new Section 10.9 after the headings/counterparts paragraph: CGL USD 1M per occurrence / 2M aggregate, E&O USD 2M, cyber USD 5M, statutory workers' compensation, term plus one year, certificates on request — with the E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M fallback offered in the comment.
